title: AW169 EP Quick Reference
intro: For training use only. This is an informal quick reference of selected AW169 RFM limitations. Always use the official RFM / QRH as primary reference.

items.label: AEO
lines: At or below 90 KIAS — Max continuous: 100%
At or below 90 KIAS — Max take-off: 122% (30 min; 5 min with EAPS kit)
Above 90 KIAS — Max continuous: 100% / Max transient: 132% (10 s)

items.label: AEO power-on
lines: Variable governing with PLUS-mode (datum varies with airspeed and density altitude)
Green band ±2% around the datum; red indication and aural warning at ±3%

items.label: General
lines: Max airspeed AEO with TQ above 100%: 90 KIAS
Max IFR approach: 130 KIAS at and below 5000 ft, then minus 2 kt / 1000 ft above
Max with one AP failed: 120 KIAS

items.label: Slope limits (basic configuration)
lines: Sloped take‑off and landing limited to:

items.label: Wheel brake & parking
lines: Max running speed for wheel brake application: 40 knots GS
Parking on dry, paved slopes up to 12° permitted for max 20 hours.

items.label: Ground speed (selected)
lines: On paved surfaces (dry, paved): max taxi speed 40 knots GS, rolling take-off / running landing 60 knots GS, max emergency landing speed 60 knots GS
On prepared grass: max taxi speed 20 knots GS
Rolling take-off / running landing: 30 knots GS
Max emergency landing speed: 50 knots GS

items.label: Wind for engine/rotor start & stop
lines: Limit is a wind envelope (RFM Figure 1-9): red limit line at 40 kt for most wind directions, 50 kt in a narrow sector dead ahead (355° to 5°)
Parking: if forecast wind exceeds 50 knots, park in a sheltered area or hangar.

items.label: Basic RFM Section 1
lines: Max gross weight for towing / taxi: 4650 kg
Max gross weight for CAT B take-off / landing: 4600 kg
Min flight / rotor-running gross weight: 3300 kg

items.label: Increased gross weight (Supplement 30)
lines: Max gross weight for towing / taxi: 4850 kg
Max gross weight for take-off / landing: 4800 kg
